main.name: blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot
main.statement: theorem blackForm_tendsto_zero_iff_dpl_tendsto_atBot (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) : Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k (w k)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ↔ Filter.Tendsto (fun k ↦ MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k (w k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
main.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    rw [Filter.tendsto_atBot] at hn
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := not_forall.mp hn
    have hf := Filter.not_eventually.mp hM
    obtain ⟨c, hc, R, hR⟩ := blackForm_lower_bound_of_dpl_ge w hw M
    obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk1, hk2⟩, hk3⟩ := ((hf.and_eventually (h.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hc))).and_eventually (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop R)).exists
    have h4 := hR k hk3 (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hk1))
    exact (not_lt.mpr h4) hk2
  · intro h
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds (Phi_tendsto_zero_atBot.comp h) (fun k => (blackForm_nonneg_le_Phi_dpl k (w k) (hw k)).1) (fun k => (blackForm_nonneg_le_Phi_dpl k (w k) (hw k)).2)

leaves.name: blackForm_lower_bound_of_dpl_ge
leaves.statement: theorem blackForm_lower_bound_of_dpl_ge (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 < w k) (M : ℝ) : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ k : ℝ, R ≤ k → M ≤ MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k (w k) → c ≤ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k (w k)

leaves.name: blackForm_nonneg_le_Phi_dpl
leaves.statement: theorem blackForm_nonneg_le_Phi_dpl (k w : ℝ) (hw : 0 < w) : 0 ≤ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k w ∧ MathFin.ForwardSmile.blackForm k w ≤ MathFin.Phi (MathFin.ForwardSmile.dpl k w)
